import time
import numpy as np
from anomalib.data import Folder
from anomalib.models import Patchcore
from anomalib.engine import Engine
from lightning.pytorch.callbacks import TQDMProgressBar

t0 = time.time()
data = Folder(
    name="capsule", 
    root="capsule",
    normal_dir="train/good",
    abnormal_dir=[f"test/{d}" for d in DEFECTS],
    normal_test_dir="test/good",
    mask_dir=[f"ground_truth/{d}" for d in DEFECTS],
    train_batch_size=8, 
    eval_batch_size=8, 
    num_workers=0
)

amodel = Patchcore()

# RichProgressBar 충돌 방지를 위해 TQDM 콜백 전달
engine = Engine(
    max_epochs=1, 
    accelerator="gpu", 
    devices=1,
    callbacks=[TQDMProgressBar(refresh_rate=50)]
)

engine.fit(datamodule=data, model=amodel)
res = engine.test(datamodule=data, model=amodel)[0]

auroc = float(res.get("image_AUROC", np.nan))
auroc_display = 0.0 if np.isnan(auroc) else auroc

print("="*54)
print(f"학습에 사용한 불량 사진 0장 · 정상 219장 · 소요 {time.time()-t0:.0f}초")
print(f"이미지 AUROC {auroc_display:.3f}   (강사 실측 0.99+ · 만점 1.0)")
print(f"이미지 F1 {float(res.get('image_F1Score', np.nan)):.3f} · 픽셀 AUROC {float(res.get('pixel_AUROC', np.nan)):.3f}")
print("="*54)
